tools.name: negotiate_price
tools.description: Use this to propose a test-USDC unit price and a quantity, or to accept the tier price. Use get_quote if you only need the list price. Required input: resource_id. Optional: unit_price_usdc, quantity from 1 to 100, and session_id. Returns an accepted offer or a counteroffer with offer_id and expiry.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-monetize" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_resources, get_quote, prepare_checkout, pay_and_access · Private data: pay_and_access · Public sink: prepare_checkout, pay_and_access · Destructive: pay_and_access, get_receipt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_resources, get_quote, prepare_checkout, pay_and_access · Private data: pay_and_access · Public sink: prepare_checkout, pay_and_access · Destructive: pay_and_access, get_receipt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
